# Sockets

Address families, socket types and options, and the calls that open, bind and connect sockets.


[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/FreeBSD/Src/Socket.rux#L52)

`SO_RCVTIMEO`: how long a receive waits.

<h2 id="socket"><code>Socket</code></h2>

```rux
pub func Socket(
    domain: int32,
    kind: int32,
    protocol: int32
) -> int64
```

Opens a socket.

**See also**: [https://man.freebsd.org/cgi/man.cgi?query=socket&sektion=2](https://man.freebsd.org/cgi/man.cgi?query=socket&sektion=2)

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/FreeBSD/Src/Socket.rux#L96)

**Parameters**

| Name       | Type    | Description                                                                                                                                           |
| ---------- | ------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `domain`   | `int32` | the address family, such as [`AF_INET`](/docs/api/freebsd/socket#af-inet)                                                                             |
| `kind`     | `int32` | the socket type, such as [`SOCK_STREAM`](/docs/api/freebsd/socket#sock-stream), combined with [`SOCK_CLOEXEC`](/docs/api/freebsd/socket#sock-cloexec) |
| `protocol` | `int32` | the protocol, or zero for the family's default                                                                                                        |

**Returns**: the new descriptor, or a negative error number

<h2 id="connect"><code>Connect</code></h2>

```rux
pub func Connect(
    fd: FileDescriptor,
    address: *opaque,
    length: uint32
) -> int64
```

Connects a socket to `address`, waiting for a stream connection to be made.

**See also**: [https://man.freebsd.org/cgi/man.cgi?query=connect&sektion=2](https://man.freebsd.org/cgi/man.cgi?query=connect&sektion=2)

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/FreeBSD/Src/Socket.rux#L107)

**Parameters**

| Name      | Type             | Description                 |
| --------- | ---------------- | --------------------------- |
| `fd`      | `FileDescriptor` | the socket                  |
| `address` | `*opaque`        | the address, a `sockaddr`   |
| `length`  | `uint32`         | the address's size in bytes |

**Returns**: zero, or a negative error number

<h2 id="listen"><code>Listen</code></h2>

```rux
pub func Listen(fd: FileDescriptor, backlog: int32) -> int64
```

Makes a bound stream socket accept connections.

**See also**: [https://man.freebsd.org/cgi/man.cgi?query=listen&sektion=2](https://man.freebsd.org/cgi/man.cgi?query=listen&sektion=2)

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/FreeBSD/Src/Socket.rux#L128)

**Parameters**

| Name      | Type             | Description                                  |
| --------- | ---------------- | -------------------------------------------- |
| `fd`      | `FileDescriptor` | the socket                                   |
| `backlog` | `int32`          | how many connections may wait to be accepted |

**Returns**: zero, or a negative error number

<h2 id="accept4"><code>Accept4</code></h2>

```rux
pub func Accept4(
    fd: FileDescriptor,
    address: *var opaque,
    length: *var uint32,
    flags: int32
) -> int64
```

Accepts a waiting connection as a new socket.

**See also**: [https://man.freebsd.org/cgi/man.cgi?query=accept4&sektion=2](https://man.freebsd.org/cgi/man.cgi?query=accept4&sektion=2)

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/FreeBSD/Src/Socket.rux#L140)

**Parameters**

| Name      | Type             | Description                                                                               |
| --------- | ---------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `fd`      | `FileDescriptor` | the listening socket                                                                      |
| `address` | `*var opaque`    | receives the peer's address, or null                                                      |
| `length`  | `*var uint32`    | the address buffer's size, then the address's, or null                                    |
| `flags`   | `int32`          | flags for the new socket, such as [`SOCK_CLOEXEC`](/docs/api/freebsd/socket#sock-cloexec) |

**Returns**: the new descriptor, or a negative error number

<h2 id="sendto"><code>SendTo</code></h2>

```rux
pub func SendTo(
    fd: FileDescriptor,
    buffer: *opaque,
    count: uint,
    flags: int32,
    address: *opaque,
    length: uint32
) -> int64
```

Sends bytes on a socket, to `address` when it is not connected.

**See also**: [https://man.freebsd.org/cgi/man.cgi?query=sendto&sektion=2](https://man.freebsd.org/cgi/man.cgi?query=sendto&sektion=2)

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/FreeBSD/Src/Socket.rux#L154)

**Parameters**

| Name      | Type             | Description                                                           |
| --------- | ---------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `fd`      | `FileDescriptor` | the socket                                                            |
| `buffer`  | `*opaque`        | the bytes                                                             |
| `count`   | `uint`           | how many                                                              |
| `flags`   | `int32`          | flags such as [`MSG_NOSIGNAL`](/docs/api/freebsd/socket#msg-nosignal) |
| `address` | `*opaque`        | the destination, or null for a connected socket                       |
| `length`  | `uint32`         | the destination's size                                                |

**Returns**: the bytes sent, or a negative error number

<h2 id="receivefrom"><code>ReceiveFrom</code></h2>

```rux
pub func ReceiveFrom(
    fd: FileDescriptor,
    buffer: *var opaque,
    count: uint,
    flags: int32,
    address: *var opaque,
    length: *var uint32
) -> int64
```

Receives bytes from a socket, and where they came from.

**See also**: [https://man.freebsd.org/cgi/man.cgi?query=recvfrom&sektion=2](https://man.freebsd.org/cgi/man.cgi?query=recvfrom&sektion=2)

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/FreeBSD/Src/Socket.rux#L168)

**Parameters**

| Name      | Type             | Description                                            |
| --------- | ---------------- | ------------------------------------------------------ |
| `fd`      | `FileDescriptor` | the socket                                             |
| `buffer`  | `*var opaque`    | receives the bytes                                     |
| `count`   | `uint`           | how many fit                                           |
| `flags`   | `int32`          | flags, or zero                                         |
| `address` | `*var opaque`    | receives the sender's address, or null                 |
| `length`  | `*var uint32`    | the address buffer's size, then the address's, or null |

**Returns**: the bytes received, zero once a stream's peer closed it, or a negative error number
